intro.en: A boy comes home carrying many prizes and talks with his mother and father. Notice how he stays humble and thanks his parents with the du'a «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek bacha bahut se inaamaat le kar ghar aata hai aur ammi abbu se baat karta hai. Dhyan dein ke woh kitna aajiz hai aur dua «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً» se unka shukriya ada karta hai.
intro.ar: وَلَدٌ يَعودُ إِلى البَيْتِ وَمَعَهُ جَوائِزُ كَثيرَةٌ وَيَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ أُمِّهِ وَأَبيهِ. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَتَواضَعُ وَيَشْكُرُ والِدَيْهِ بِدُعاءِ «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً».

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَحْمِلُ يا وَلَدي؟ ما هَذِهِ الأَشْياءُ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taḥmilu yā waladī? mā hādhihi l-ashyāʾ?
dialogue.en: What are you carrying, my son? What are these things?
dialogue.ur: Beta, aap kya utha rahe hain? Yeh sab cheezein kya hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ جَوائِزُ. ساعِدوني، فَالجَوائِزُ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi jawāʾiz. sāʿidūnī, fa-l-jawāʾizu kathīra
dialogue.en: These are prizes. Help me, there are many prizes.
dialogue.ur: Yeh inaamaat hain. Meri madad karein, inaamaat bahut hain.

dialogue.ar: ما الجَوائِزُ الَّتي حَصَلْتَ عَلَيْها؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-jawāʾizu llatī ḥaṣalta ʿalayhā?
dialogue.en: Which prizes did you get?
dialogue.ur: Aapko kaun kaun se inaamaat mile?

dialogue.ar: حَصَلْتُ عَلى جائِزَةِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، وَجائِزَةِ السّيرَةِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ، وَجائِزَةِ المَعْلوماتِ العامَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaṣaltu ʿalā jāʾizati l-Qurʾāni l-karīm, wa jāʾizati s-sīrati n-nabawiyya, wa jāʾizati l-maʿlūmāti l-ʿāmma
dialogue.en: I got the Holy Quran prize, the Prophet's biography prize and the general knowledge prize.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe Quran-e-Kareem ka inaam, seerat-e-nabawi ka inaam aur aam maloomaat ka inaam mila.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ اللهُ! فَقَدْ حَصَلَ وَلَدي عَلى جَوائِزِ المُسابَقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh! fa-qad ḥaṣala waladī ʿalā jawāʾizi l-musābaqa
dialogue.en: Masha Allah! My son has won the prizes of the competition.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Mere bete ne muqable ke inaamaat jeet liye.

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ المُنافَسَةُ شَديدَةً جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: kānati l-munāfasatu shadīdatan jiddan
dialogue.en: The competition was very strong.
dialogue.ur: Muqabla bahut sakht tha.

dialogue.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ صَديقُكَ حُسامٌ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā faʿala ṣadīquka Ḥusām?
dialogue.en: What did your friend Husam do?
dialogue.ur: Aapke dost Husam ne kya kiya?

dialogue.ar: حَصَلَ عَلى جائِزَةِ الحَديثِ وَجائِزَةِ الخَطابَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaṣala ʿalā jāʾizati l-ḥadīth wa jāʾizati l-khaṭāba
dialogue.en: He got the Hadith prize and the public speaking prize.
dialogue.ur: Usay hadees ka inaam aur taqreer ka inaam mila.

dialogue.ar: هَذا أَسْعَدُ يَوْمٍ في حَياتي!
dialogue.tr: hādhā asʿadu yawmin fī ḥayātī
dialogue.en: This is the happiest day of my life!
dialogue.ur: Yeh meri zindagi ka sab se khush din hai!

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَنا.
dialogue.tr: laqad rafaʿta raʾsanā
dialogue.en: You have made us proud.
dialogue.ur: Aapne hamara sar uncha kar diya.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتُما السَّبَبُ في نَجاحي. جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: antumā s-sababu fī najāḥī. jazākumā llāhu khayran
dialogue.en: You two are the reason for my success. May Allah reward you with good.
dialogue.ur: Meri kamyabi ka sabab aap dono hain. Allah aapko behtar badla de.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْنُ سَنُعْطيكَ جائِزَةً أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: wa naḥnu sa-nuʿṭīka jāʾizatan ayḍan
dialogue.en: And we will give you a prize too.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum bhi aapko ek inaam denge.

dialogue.ar: لا أُريدُ مِنْكُما جائِزَةً؛ فَالخَيْرُ كَثيرٌ، وَالحَمْدُ للهِ، لَكِنَّني أُريدُ مِنْكُما شَيْئاً آخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: lā urīdu minkumā jāʾizatan; fa-l-khayru kathīr, wal-ḥamdu lillāh, lākinnanī urīdu minkumā shayʾan ākhar
dialogue.en: I do not want a prize from you; there is much good, praise be to Allah, but I want something else from you.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe aap se inaam nahin chahiye; bhalai bahut hai, Alhamdulillah, lekin mujhe aap se kuch aur chahiye.

dialogue.ar: ما هُوَ؟ سَنُعْطيكَ ما تُريدُ.
dialogue.tr: mā huwa? sa-nuʿṭīka mā turīd
dialogue.en: What is it? We will give you what you want.
dialogue.ur: Woh kya hai? Hum aapko wohi denge jo aap chahte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَطْلُبُ مِنْكُما العَفْوَ وَالدُّعاءَ.
dialogue.tr: aṭlubu minkumā l-ʿafwa wad-duʿāʾ
dialogue.en: I ask you for forgiveness and your prayers.
dialogue.ur: Main aap se maafi aur dua maangta hoon.

dialogue.ar: عَفا اللهُ عَنْكَ، وَوَفَّقَكَ في حَياتِكَ وَدِراسَتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafā llāhu ʿanka, wa waffaqaka fī ḥayātika wa dirāsatik
dialogue.en: May Allah forgive you and grant you success in your life and studies.
dialogue.ur: Allah aapko maaf kare aur aapko zindagi aur parhai mein kamyabi de.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: jazākumā llāhu khayran
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you both with good.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap dono ko behtar badla de.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good
vocab.ur: Allah aapko behtar badla de (jazak Allah)

q.en: What does «جَوائِزُ» mean?
q.ur: «جَوائِزُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which prize did the boy NOT mention himself getting?
q.ur: Bachay ne apne liye kaun sa inaam nahin bataya?
q.ar: أَيُّ جائِزَةٍ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ الوَلَدُ أَنَّهُ حَصَلَ عَلَيْها؟

q.en: What does the boy ask his parents for?
q.ur: Bacha apne walidain se kya maangta hai?

q.en: The boy says to his parents: «أَنْتُما السَّبَبُ في ...»
q.ur: Bacha walidain se kehta hai: «أَنْتُما السَّبَبُ في ...»

q.en: What is the dua of thanks used in this dialogue?
q.ur: Shukriye ki kaun si dua is mukaalme mein hai?
q.ar: ما دُعاءُ الشُّكْرِ المُسْتَعْمَلُ في هَذا الحِوارِ؟

intro.en: Tanween is a silent letter noon added to the end of a word: two fathas (-ً), two dammas (-ٌ) or two kasras (-ٍ). It is pronounced when you do not stop on the word. Example: كِتابٌ – kitābun.
intro.ur: Tanween ek saakin noon hai jo lafz ke aakhir mein aata hai: do zabar (-ً), do pesh (-ٌ) ya do zer (-ٍ). Yeh us waqt parha jata hai jab lafz par ruka na jaye. Misal: كِتابٌ – kitābun.
intro.ar: التَّنْوينُ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ تَلْحَقُ آخِرَ الاسْمِ، وَهُوَ ضَمَّتانِ أَوْ فَتْحَتانِ أَوْ كَسْرَتانِ، وَيُنْطَقُ إِذا وَصَلْنا الكَلامَ وَلَمْ نَقِفْ عَلَيْهِ. مِثالٌ: كِتابٌ.

q.en: What is tanween?
q.ur: Tanween kya hai?

options: A silent noon added at the end of a word
A letter at the start of a word

q.en: Which of these has tanween of raf' (two dammas)?
q.ur: In mein se kis par tanween-e-raf' (do pesh) hai?

q.en: Which of these has tanween of nasb (two fathas)?
q.ur: In mein se kis par tanween-e-nasb (do zabar) hai?

q.en: Which word has tanween of jarr (two kasras)?
q.ur: Kis lafz par tanween-e-jarr (do zer) hai?

intro.en: To make the plural of a male person, add «ون» (wa-noon) in the raf' case, or «ين» (ya-noon) in the nasb and jarr cases. Example: مُسْلِمٌ → مُسْلِمونَ (Muslims) and مُسْلِمينَ.
intro.ur: Mard ki jama banane ke liye raf' mein «ون» (waw noon) lagate hain aur nasb o jarr mein «ين» (ya noon). Misal: مُسْلِمٌ → مُسْلِمونَ (musalman, jama) aur مُسْلِمينَ.
intro.ar: نَجْمَعُ المُذَكَّرَ العاقِلَ بِإِضافَةِ «ون» في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ، وَ«ين» في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ. مِثالٌ: مُسْلِمٌ ← مُسْلِمونَ وَمُسْلِمينَ.

q.en: How do you form the sound masculine plural in the raf' case?
q.ur: Raf' mein jam' muzakkar saalim kaise banate hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ نُكَوِّنُ جَمْعَ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ؟

q.en: Which ending is used in the nasb and jarr cases?
q.ur: Nasb aur jarr mein kaun si ending aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نِهايَةٍ تُسْتَعْمَلُ في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ؟

q.en: What is the plural of «مُسْلِمٌ» in the raf' case?
q.ur: «مُسْلِمٌ» ki raf' mein jama kya hai?

q.en: In «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ», why does the plural end with «ين»?
q.ur: «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ» mein jama «ين» par kyun khatam hoti hai?
q.ar: في «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ» لِماذا انْتَهى الجَمْعُ بِـ«ين»؟

options: It is in the nasb case (object)
It is in the raf' case

intro.en: A reading passage about why countries give prizes, what a prize may include, and the two kinds: local prizes and international prizes. Read each sentence slowly and look at the new words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka tukra hai: mulk inaamaat kyun dete hain, inaam ke saath kya milta hai, aur inaamaat ki do qismein: maqami aur aalami. Har jumla aahista parhein aur naye alfaz dekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ سَبَبِ مَنْحِ الدُّوَلِ لِلْجَوائِزِ، وَما قَدْ تَشْمَلُهُ الجائِزَةُ، وَنَوْعَيْها: جَوائِزُ مَحَلِّيَّةٌ وَجَوائِزُ دَوْلِيَّةٌ. اِقْرَأْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: تَمْنَحُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ جَوائِزَ كَثيرَةً لِلْمُبْدِعينَ.
dialogue.tr: tamnaḥu kathīrun mina d-duwali jawāʾiza kathīratan lil-mubdiʿīn
dialogue.en: Many countries give many prizes to creative people.
dialogue.ur: Bahut se mulk mubdi' logon ko bahut se inaamaat dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالهَدَفُ مِنْ تِلْكَ الجَوائِزِ خِدْمَةُ العُلومِ وَالآدابِ وَغَيْرِها.
dialogue.tr: wal-hadafu min tilka l-jawāʾizi khidmatu l-ʿulūmi wal-ādābi wa ghayrihā
dialogue.en: The aim of these prizes is to serve the sciences, literature and more.
dialogue.ur: In inaamaat ka maqsad uloom, adab aur doosri cheezon ki khidmat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَكونُ الجائِزَةُ في الغالِبِ مُكافَأَةً مالِيَّةً، تَخْتَلِفُ قيمَتُها مِنْ بَلَدٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa takūnu l-jāʾizatu fī l-ghālibi mukāfaʾatan māliyya, takhtalifu qīmatuhā min baladin ilā balad
dialogue.en: The prize is usually a financial reward whose value differs from one country to another.
dialogue.ur: Inaam aksar maali inaam hota hai, jis ki qeemat mulk mulk badalti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَصْحَبُ المُكافَأَةَ المالِيَّةَ: دِرْعٌ، أَوْ شَهادَةٌ، أَوْ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad yaṣḥabu l-mukāfaʾata l-māliyya: dirʿ, aw shahāda, aw ghayru dhālik
dialogue.en: The financial reward may come with a shield, a certificate or something else.
dialogue.ur: Maali inaam ke saath shield, sanad ya koi aur cheez bhi ho sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَنْقَسِمُ الجَوائِزُ إِلى قِسْمَيْنِ: جَوائِزُ مَحَلِّيَّةٌ، وَجَوائِزُ عالَمِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: tanqasimu l-jawāʾizu ilā qismayn: jawāʾizu maḥalliyya, wa jawāʾizu ʿālamiyya
dialogue.en: Prizes are divided into two kinds: local prizes and international prizes.
dialogue.ur: Inaamaat do qismon mein bantay hain: maqami inaamaat aur aalami inaamaat.

dialogue.ar: الجَوائِزُ المَحَلِّيَّةُ هِيَ الَّتي تَمْنَحُها الدَّوْلَةُ لِأَبْنائِها الَّذينَ يَخْدِمونَ العِلْمَ وَالثَّقافَةَ في بَلَدِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: al-jawāʾizu l-maḥalliyyatu hiya llatī tamnaḥuhā d-dawlatu li-abnāʾihā lladhīna yakhdimūna l-ʿilma wath-thaqāfata fī baladihim
dialogue.en: Local prizes are those the state gives to its own sons who serve knowledge and culture in their country.
dialogue.ur: Maqami inaamaat woh hain jo riyasat apne un beton ko deti hai jo apne mulk mein ilm aur saqafat ki khidmat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الجَوائِزُ العالَمِيَّةُ فَتَمْنَحُها هَيْئاتٌ عالَمِيَّةٌ لِلْأَشْخاصِ الَّذينَ يَخْدِمونَ الإِنْسانِيَّةَ في جَميعِ أَنْحاءِ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-jawāʾizu l-ʿālamiyyatu fa-tamnaḥuhā hayʾātun ʿālamiyyatun lil-ashkhāṣi lladhīna yakhdimūna l-insāniyyata fī jamīʿi anḥāʾi l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: As for international prizes, international bodies give them to people who serve humanity all over the world.
dialogue.ur: Rahe aalami inaamaat, to aalami idaray unhein un logon ko dete hain jo poori duniya mein insaniyat ki khidmat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الجَوائِزِ العالَمِيَّةِ المَشْهورَةِ: جَوائِزُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل العالَمِيَّةُ، الَّتي تَمْنَحُها مُؤَسَّسَةُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل الخَيْرِيَّةُ بِالمَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa mina l-jawāʾizi l-ʿālamiyyati l-mashhūra: jawāʾizu l-maliki Fayṣal al-ʿālamiyya, llatī tamnaḥuhā muʾassasatu l-maliki Fayṣal al-khayriyya bil-mamlakati l-ʿarabiyyati s-suʿūdiyya
dialogue.en: Among the famous international prizes are the King Faisal International Prizes, given by the King Faisal Foundation in Saudi Arabia.
dialogue.ur: Mashhoor aalami inaamaat mein Shah Faisal aalami inaamaat hain, jo Saudi Arabia mein Shah Faisal Khairiya Foundation deti hai.

vocab.ur: woh rakhta hai, muqarrar karta hai

q.en: What is the aim of these prizes, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq in inaamaat ka maqsad kya hai?
q.ar: ما هَدَفُ هَذِهِ الجَوائِزِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who gives local prizes?
q.ur: Maqami inaamaat kaun deta hai?

options: The state to its own people

q.en: Who gives international prizes?
q.ur: Aalami inaamaat kaun deta hai?

q.en: The King Faisal Foundation is in which country?
q.ur: Shah Faisal Foundation kis mulk mein hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ بَلَدٍ تَقَعُ مُؤَسَّسَةُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل؟

q.en: A prize is usually a financial reward. What else may come with it?
q.ur: Inaam aam taur par maali hota hai. Iske saath aur kya ho sakta hai?
q.ar: الجائِزَةُ في الغالِبِ مُكافَأَةٌ مالِيَّةٌ. فَماذا يُمْنَحُ مَعَها أَيْضاً؟

intro.en: Feminine is the opposite of masculine. In nouns the signs are: ta' marbuta (فاطِمَةُ), alif maqsura (سَلْمى) and alif mamduda (سَمْراءُ). In verbs: a silent ta' at the end of the past verb (خَرَجَتْ) and a ta' at the start of the present verb (تَخْرُجُ).
intro.ur: Ta'neeth, tazkeer ka ulta hai. Ismon mein alaamaat: ta marbuta (فاطِمَةُ), alif maqsura (سَلْمى) aur alif mamduda (سَمْراءُ). Fe'lon mein: maazi ke aakhir mein saakin ta (خَرَجَتْ) aur mudaare' ke shuru mein ta (تَخْرُجُ).
intro.ar: المُؤَنَّثُ ضِدُّ المُذَكَّرِ. عَلاماتُهُ في الأَسْماءِ: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (فاطِمَةُ)، وَالأَلِفُ المَقْصورَةُ (سَلْمى)، وَالأَلِفُ المَمْدودَةُ (سَمْراءُ). وَفي الأَفْعالِ: تاءٌ ساكِنَةٌ في آخِرِ الماضي (خَرَجَتْ)، وَتاءٌ في أَوَّلِ المُضارِعِ (تَخْرُجُ).

q.en: Which word ends with ta' marbuta?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ta marbuta par khatam hota hai?

q.en: Which word ends with alif maqsura?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz alif maqsura par khatam hota hai?

q.en: What marks a feminine past verb, like «خَرَجَتْ»?
q.ur: Muannas maazi fe'l, jaise «خَرَجَتْ», ki nishani kya hai?
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ تَأْنيثِ الفِعْلِ الماضي مِثْلِ «خَرَجَتْ»؟

options: A silent ta' at the end

q.en: What marks a feminine present verb, like «تَخْرُجُ»?

intro.en: The school principal and the teachers meet to choose the ideal student. Each teacher names one quality. Note that the prize at the end is books, a bag and some money.
intro.ur: School ke principal aur ustaad misali talib-e-ilm chunne ke liye jama hote hain. Har ustaad ek khoobi bataata hai. Aakhir mein inaam kitabein, ek bag aur kuch raqam hai.
intro.ar: يَجْتَمِعُ مُديرُ المَدْرَسَةِ وَالمُعَلِّمونَ لِاخْتِيارِ الطّالِبِ المِثالِيِّ، وَيَذْكُرُ كُلُّ مُعَلِّمٍ صِفَةً. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى أَنَّ الجائِزَةَ في النِّهايَةِ كُتُبٌ وَحَقيبَةٌ وَمَبْلَغٌ مِنَ المالِ.

dialogue.ar: نَجْتَمِعُ اليَوْمَ لاخْتِيارِ الطّالِبِ المِثالِيِّ. ما صِفاتُ الطّالِبِ المِثالِيِّ في رَأْيِكُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: najtamiʿu l-yawma likhtiyāri ṭ-ṭālibi l-mithālī. mā ṣifātu ṭ-ṭālibi l-mithāliyyi fī raʾyikum?
dialogue.en: We meet today to choose the ideal student. What are the qualities of the ideal student in your opinion?
dialogue.ur: Aaj hum misali talib-e-ilm chunne ke liye jama hue hain. Aapki raaye mein misali talib-e-ilm ki khoobiyan kya hain?

dialogue.ar: أَنْ يُحافِظَ عَلى صَلاتِهِ، وَأَنْ يَكونَ حَسَنَ الأَخْلاقِ.
dialogue.tr: an yuḥāfiẓa ʿalā ṣalātih, wa an yakūna ḥasana l-akhlāq
dialogue.en: That he keeps up his prayers and has good manners.
dialogue.ur: Woh apni namaz ki hifazat kare aur achay akhlaq wala ho.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ يَهْتَمَّ بِنَظافَتِهِ وَمَظْهَرِهِ؛ وَأَنْ يَكونَ مَحْبوباً لَدى زُمَلائِهِ وَمُدَرِّسيهِ.
dialogue.tr: an yahtamma bi-naẓāfatihi wa maẓharih; wa an yakūna maḥbūban ladā zumalāʾihi wa mudarrisīh
dialogue.en: That he cares about his cleanliness and appearance, and is loved by his classmates and teachers.
dialogue.ur: Woh apni safai aur zahiri hulye ka khayal rakhe, aur apne saathiyon aur ustaadon ka mehboob ho.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ يَحْصُلَ عَلى امْتِيازٍ في الاخْتِباراتِ.
dialogue.tr: an yaḥṣula ʿalā imtiyāzin fī l-ikhtibārāt
dialogue.en: That he gets excellent marks in the exams.
dialogue.ur: Woh imtehanaat mein imtiyaz (umda number) hasil kare.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ يُشارِكَ في المُسابَقاتِ الثَّقافِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: an yushārika fī l-musābaqāti th-thaqāfiyya
dialogue.en: That he takes part in cultural competitions.
dialogue.ur: Woh saqafati muqablon mein hissa le.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنْ يُشارِكَ في الأَنْشِطَةِ الرِّياضِيَّةِ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: wa an yushārika fī l-anshiṭati r-riyāḍiyyati ayḍan
dialogue.en: And that he also takes part in sports activities.
dialogue.ur: Aur woh khelon ki sargarmiyon mein bhi hissa le.

dialogue.ar: وَالآنَ يَخْتارُ كُلُّ واحِدٍ مِنْكُمْ ثَلاثَةَ طُلّابٍ، وَيَكْتُبُ أَسْماءَهُمْ في البِطاقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-āna yakhtāru kullu wāḥidin minkum thalāthata ṭullābin, wa yaktubu asmāʾahum fī l-biṭāqa
dialogue.en: Now each one of you chooses three students and writes their names on the card.
dialogue.ur: Ab aap mein se har ek teen talib-e-ilm chunega aur unke naam card par likhega.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ اسْمٌ مُشْتَرَكٌ في جَميعِ البِطاقاتِ: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلّام، هُوَ الطّالِبُ المِثالِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka ismun mushtarakun fī jamīʿi l-biṭāqāt: Aḥmadu bnu ʿAllām, huwa ṭ-ṭālibu l-mithālī
dialogue.en: There is a name common to all the cards: Ahmad ibn Allam. He is the ideal student.
dialogue.ur: Tamam cards mein ek naam mushtarak hai: Ahmad bin Allam. Wohi misali talib-e-ilm hai.

dialogue.ar: سَنُعْلِنُ النَّتيجَةَ لِلطُّلّابِ في الأُسْبوعِ القادِمِ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: sa-nuʿlinu n-natījata liṭ-ṭullābi fī l-usbūʿi l-qādim, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: We will announce the result to the students next week, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Hum agle hafte, ان شاء اللہ, talba ko nateeja bataenge.

dialogue.ar: الجائِزَةُ: كُتُبٌ، وَحَقيبَةٌ، وَمَبْلَغٌ مِنَ المالِ، وَسَوْفَ يَكونُ هُناكَ حَفْلٌ كَبيرٌ، يَحْضُرُهُ آباءُ الطُّلّابِ.
dialogue.tr: al-jāʾiza: kutub, wa ḥaqība, wa mablaghun mina l-māl, wa sawfa yakūnu hunāka ḥaflun kabīr, yaḥḍuruhu ābāʾu ṭ-ṭullāb
dialogue.en: The prize: books, a bag and a sum of money, and there will be a big ceremony attended by the students' fathers.
dialogue.ur: Inaam: kitabein, ek bag aur kuch raqam, aur ek bada jashn hoga jis mein talba ke walid shareek honge.

title.en: Particles that put the present verb in nasb: «أَنْ» and «لَنْ»
title.ur: Mudaare' ko nasb dene walay huroof: «أَنْ» aur «لَنْ»

intro.en: After «أَنْ» (that, to) and «لَنْ» (will never) the present verb takes a fatha on its last letter. Example: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الْمُسْلِمُ – the Muslim must perform wudu. And: لَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ – he will never leave the prayer.
intro.ur: «أَنْ» (ke) aur «لَنْ» (hargiz nahin) ke baad mudaare' fe'l ke aakhir par zabar aata hai. Misal: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الْمُسْلِمُ – musalman par wuzu karna wajib hai. Aur: لَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ – woh namaz hargiz nahin chhodega.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «أَنْ» وَ«لَنْ» يُنْصَبُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ فَيَأْخُذُ فَتْحَةً عَلى آخِرِهِ. مِثالٌ: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ المُسْلِمُ، وَلَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الابْنُ لِأَبيهِ: إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ، وَلَنْ يُهْمِلَ دُروسَهُ، وَلَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ عَنِ الدِّراسَةِ بَعْدَ اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: qāla l-ibnu li-abīhi: innahu lan yatruka ṣ-ṣalāta, wa lan yuhmila durūsah, wa lan yataʾakhkhara ʿani d-dirāsati baʿda l-yawm
dialogue.en: The son said to his father: he will never leave the prayer, will never neglect his lessons and will not be late for study after today.
dialogue.ur: Bete ne apne walid se kaha: woh namaz hargiz nahin chhodega, apne sabaq ki ankhein band nahin karega aur aaj ke baad parhai mein der nahin karega.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ أَرادَ أَنْ يَصومَ فَلْيَتَسَحَّرْ بِشَيْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: man arāda an yaṣūma fal-yatasaḥḥar bi-shayʾ
dialogue.en: Whoever wants to fast, let him eat the pre-dawn meal with something.
dialogue.ur: Jo roza rakhna chahe woh kuch cheez se sehri kar le.

dialogue.ar: مَنِ اسْتَطاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخاهُ، فَلْيَنْفَعْهُ.
dialogue.tr: man istaṭāʿa minkum an yanfaʿa akhāh, fal-yanfaʿh
dialogue.en: Whoever among you is able to benefit his brother, let him benefit him.
dialogue.ur: Tum mein se jo apne bhai ko faida pohancha sake, woh pohancha de.

intro.en: Listen to the text, then choose the correct answer for each question. The questions are about Bint al-Shati', an Arab woman writer and teacher who won prizes for her work. Try to understand the question words: كانَتْ (she was), حَصَلَتْ عَلى (she got), كَتَبَتْ (she wrote).
intro.ur: Matn sunein, phir har sawal ka sahi jawab chunein. Sawalat Bint al-Shati' ke baare mein hain, jo ek arab ustaani aur musannifa thin aur unhein apne kaam par inaamaat mile. Alfaz yaad karein: كانَتْ (woh thi), حَصَلَتْ عَلى (usay mila), كَتَبَتْ (usne likha).
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى النَّصِّ ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. الأَسْئِلَةُ عَنْ بِنْتِ الشّاطِئِ، كاتِبَةٍ وَمُعَلِّمَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ نالَتْ جَوائِزَ عَلى أَعْمالِها. تَعَرَّفْ عَلى الأَفْعالِ: كانَتْ، حَصَلَتْ عَلى، كَتَبَتْ.

intro.en: A longer reading about the King Faisal International Prize: when it started, its five fields, what the winner receives, and some famous people who won it.
intro.ur: Shah Faisal aalami inaam ke baare mein ek lamba matn: yeh kab shuru hua, iske paanch shobay, jeetne wale ko kya milta hai, aur kuch mashhoor logon ke naam jinhon ne yeh inaam hasil kiya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ أَطْوَلُ عَنْ جائِزَةِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل العالَمِيَّةِ: مَتى بَدَأَتْ، وَمَجالاتُها الخَمْسَةُ، وَما يَنالُهُ الفائِزُ، وَبَعْضُ المَشاهيرِ الَّذينَ فازوا بِها.

dialogue.ar: تَمْنَحُ مُؤَسَّسَةُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل الخَيْرِيَّةُ، مُنْذُ عامِ ١٣٩٧هـ، خَمْسَ جَوائِزَ عالَمِيَّةً، في خَمْسَةِ مَجالاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: tamnaḥu muʾassasatu l-maliki Fayṣal al-khayriyya, mundhu ʿāmi 1397 h, khamsa jawāʾiza ʿālamiyya, fī khamsati majālāt
dialogue.en: The King Faisal Charitable Foundation has given five international prizes in five fields since the year 1397 AH.
dialogue.ur: Shah Faisal Khairiya Foundation 1397 hijri se paanch shobon mein paanch aalami inaamaat deti hai.

dialogue.ar: هِيَ: خِدْمَةُ الإِسْلامِ، وَالدِّراساتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ، وَالأَدَبُ العَرَبِيُّ، وَالطِّبُّ، وَالعُلومُ.
dialogue.tr: hiya: khidmatu l-islām, wad-dirāsātu l-islāmiyya, wal-adabu l-ʿarabī, waṭ-ṭibb, wal-ʿulūm
dialogue.en: They are: service to Islam, Islamic studies, Arabic literature, medicine and science.
dialogue.ur: Yeh hain: Islam ki khidmat, Islami tehqeeqat, arabi adab, tibb aur uloom.

dialogue.ar: وَتَتَكَوَّنُ الجائِزَةُ مِنْ شَهادَةٍ تَحْمِلُ اسْمَ الفائِزِ، وَمُلَخَّصٍ لِلْعَمَلِ الَّذي حَصَلَ بِهِ عَلى الجائِزَةِ، وَميدالِيَّةٍ ذَهَبِيَّةٍ، وَمَبْلَغٍ مالِيٍّ.
dialogue.tr: wa tatakawwanu l-jāʾizatu min shahādatin taḥmilu isma l-fāʾiz, wa mulakhkhaṣin lil-ʿamali lladhī ḥaṣala bihi ʿalā l-jāʾiza, wa mīdāliyyatin dhahabiyya, wa mablaghin mālī
dialogue.en: The prize consists of a certificate with the winner's name, a summary of the work for which he won, a gold medal and a sum of money.
dialogue.ur: Inaam ek sanad par mushtamil hota hai jis par jeetne wale ka naam hota hai, us kaam ka khulasa jis par inaam mila, sone ka tamgha aur kuch raqam.

dialogue.ar: فازَ بِجَوائِزِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل كَثيرٌ مِنَ العُلَماءِ، مِنَ الشَّرْقِ وَالغَرْبِ.
dialogue.tr: fāza bi-jawāʾizi l-maliki Fayṣal kathīrun mina l-ʿulamāʾ, mina sh-sharqi wal-gharb
dialogue.en: Many scholars from the East and the West have won King Faisal's prizes.
dialogue.ur: Shah Faisal ke inaamaat mashriq o maghrib ke bahut se ulama ne jeete.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَشْهَرِ الَّذينَ نالوا جائِزَةَ خِدْمَةِ الإِسْلامِ: أَبو الأَعْلى المَوْدودِيُّ مِنْ باكِسْتانَ، وَأَبو الحَسَنِ النَّدْوِيُّ مِنَ الهِنْدِ، وَأَحْمَد ديدات مِنْ جَنوبِ إِفْريقِيا، وَعَبْدُ العَزيزِ بْنُ باز مِنَ السُّعودِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa min ashhari lladhīna nālū jāʾizata khidmati l-islām: Abū l-Aʿlā l-Mawdūdī min Bākistān, wa Abū l-Ḥasani n-Nadwī mina l-Hind, wa Aḥmad Dīdāt min janūbi Ifrīqiyā, wa ʿAbdu l-ʿAzīzi bnu Bāz mina s-Suʿūdiyya
dialogue.en: Among the most famous who received the prize for service to Islam: Abul A'la Mawdudi from Pakistan, Abul Hasan Nadwi from India, Ahmed Deedat from South Africa and Abdul Aziz ibn Baz from Saudi Arabia.
dialogue.ur: Khidmat-e-Islam ka inaam paane walon mein mashhoor: Abul A'la Maududi (Pakistan), Abul Hasan Nadwi (Hind), Ahmed Deedat (Junubi Africa) aur Abdul Aziz bin Baz (Saudi Arabia).

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الَّذينَ حَصَلوا عَلى جائِزَةِ الدِّراساتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ: فُؤاد سزكين مِنْ تُرْكِيا، وَيوسُف القَرَضاوي مِنْ مِصْرَ، وَمُصْطَفى الزَّرْقا مِنْ سوريّا.
dialogue.tr: wa mina lladhīna ḥaṣalū ʿalā jāʾizati d-dirāsāti l-islāmiyya: Fuʾād Sezgin min Turkiyā, wa Yūsuf al-Qaraḍāwī min Miṣr, wa Muṣṭafā z-Zarqā min Sūriyā
dialogue.en: Among those who got the Islamic Studies prize: Fuat Sezgin from Turkey, Yusuf al-Qaradawi from Egypt and Mustafa al-Zarqa from Syria.
dialogue.ur: Islami tehqeeqat ka inaam paane walon mein: Fuad Sezgin (Turkey), Yusuf al-Qaradawi (Misr) aur Mustafa al-Zarqa (Syria).

dialogue.ar: وَمِنَ الَّذينَ حَصَلوا عَلى جائِزَةِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل في الطِّبِّ: مايكل فيلد مِنْ أَمْريكا، وَماريو رينريتو مِنْ إِيطاليا، وَأَلبرت رينولدز مِنْ سويسرا.
dialogue.tr: wa mina lladhīna ḥaṣalū ʿalā jāʾizati l-maliki Fayṣal fiṭ-ṭibb: Māykil Fīld min Amrīkā, wa Māryū Rīnrītū min Īṭāliyā, wa Albirt Rīnūldz min Swīsrā
dialogue.en: Among those who won the King Faisal prize in medicine: Michael Field from America, Mario Renato from Italy and Albert Reynolds from Switzerland.
dialogue.ur: Tibb mein Shah Faisal inaam paane walon mein: Michael Field (America), Mario Renato (Italy) aur Albert Reynolds (Switzerland).

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَشْهَرِ الَّذينَ نالوا الجائِزَةَ في العُلومِ: أَحْمَد زُوَيْل مِنْ أَمْريكا، وَهُوَ مِصْرِيُّ الأَصْلِ، وَمايكل عَطِيَّة مِنْ بَريطانيا، وَهُوَ مَوْلودٌ في السّودانِ، وَهيربرت فالتر مِنْ أَلمانيا.
dialogue.tr: wa min ashhari lladhīna nālū l-jāʾizata fī l-ʿulūm: Aḥmad Zuwayl min Amrīkā, wa huwa Miṣriyyu l-aṣl, wa Māykil ʿAṭiyya min Barīṭāniyā, wa huwa mawlūdun fī s-Sūdān, wa Hīrbirt Fālter min Almāniyā
dialogue.en: Among the most famous who received the prize in science: Ahmed Zewail from America, who is Egyptian by origin, Michael Atiyah from Britain, who was born in Sudan, and Herbert Walter from Germany.

intro.en: Pronouns can attach to the end of a verb to show who receives the action. Example: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ – the doctor examined me. Speaker: «ي / نا»; addressed: «ك / كِ / كما / كُم / كُنَّ»; absent: «هُ / ها / هما / هم / هُنَّ».
intro.ur: Zameerein fe'l ke aakhir mein judti hain aur batati hain ke kaam kis par hua. Misal: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ – doctor ne mujhe dekha. Mutakallim: «ي / نا»; mukhatab: «ك / كِ / كما / كُم / كُنَّ»; ghaib: «هُ / ها / هما / هم / هُنَّ».
intro.ar: يَتَّصِلُ الضَّميرُ بِآخِرِ الفِعْلِ لِيَدُلَّ عَلى مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ. مِثالٌ: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ. لِلْمُتَكَلِّمِ: ي، نا. لِلْمُخاطَبِ: ك، كِ، كُما، كُمْ، كُنَّ. لِلْغائِبِ: هُ، ها، هُما، هُمْ، هُنَّ.

intro.en: Copy the verse in naskh script: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. Spelling rule: when «ال» comes before a word that starts with lam, we write both lams together without dropping any: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.
intro.ur: Aayat naskh khat mein naql karein: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. Imla ka qaida: jab «ال» aisay lafz se pehle aaye jo lam se shuru ho to dono lam saath likhte hain, koi nahin girta: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.
intro.ar: اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: إِذا دَخَلَتْ «ال» عَلى كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِلامٍ كَتَبْنا اللّامَيْنِ مَعاً دونَ حَذْفٍ: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.

intro.en: A review test that checks reading and grammar. The reading is about Hasan, an Indonesian student in Medina who learned Arabic, memorised the Quran and now reads and writes Arabic. Questions check understanding of the passage.
intro.ur: Dohrai ka imtehan jo parhne aur qawaid ko jaanchta hai. Parhna Hasan ke baare mein hai, jo Indonesia ka talib-e-ilm hai, Madina mein parhta hai, usne arabi seekhi, Quran hifz kiya aur ab arabi parhta aur likhta hai. Sawalat matn ki samajh jaanchte hain.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِلْمُراجَعَةِ في القِراءَةِ وَالقَواعِدِ. النَّصُّ عَنْ حَسَنٍ، طالِبٍ إِنْدونيسِيٍّ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ تَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَحَفِظَ القُرْآنَ وَصارَ يَقْرَأُ وَيَكْتُبُ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ. الأَسْئِلَةُ تَقيسُ فَهْمَكَ لِلنَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: حَسَنٌ طالِبٌ إِنْدونيسِيٌّ، يَدْرُسُ في الجامِعَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: Ḥasanun ṭālibun Indūnīsiyy, yadrusu fī l-jāmiʿati l-islāmiyyati fī l-madīnati l-munawwara
dialogue.en: Hasan is an Indonesian student who studies at the Islamic University in Medina.
dialogue.ur: Hasan Indonesia ka talib-e-ilm hai, jo Madina Munawwara ki Islami university mein parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ حَسَنٌ إِلى السُّعودِيَّةِ قَبْلَ ثَلاثِ سَنَواتٍ؛ لِيَتَعَلَّمَ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَيَدْرُسَ الإِسْلامَ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara Ḥasanun ilā s-Suʿūdiyyati qabla thalāthi sanawāt; li-yataʿallama l-lughata l-ʿarabiyya wa yadrusa l-islām
dialogue.en: Hasan travelled to Saudi Arabia three years ago to learn Arabic and study Islam.
dialogue.ur: Hasan teen saal pehle Saudi Arabia gaya taake arabi seekhe aur Islam parhe.

dialogue.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ حَسَنٌ العَرَبِيَّةَ الآنَ جَيِّداً، وَقَدْ بَدَأَ يَحْفَظُ القُرْآنَ الكَريمَ كُلَّهُ.
dialogue.tr: yataḥaddathu Ḥasanu l-ʿarabiyyata l-āna jayyidan, wa qad badaʾa yaḥfaẓu l-Qurʾāna l-karīma kullah
dialogue.en: Hasan now speaks Arabic well and has begun to memorise the whole Holy Quran.
dialogue.ur: Hasan ab arabi acchi bolta hai aur poora Quran-e-Kareem hifz karna shuru kar chuka hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقْرَأُ الكُتُبَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالمَجَلّاتِ الأُسْبوعِيَّةَ وَالصُّحُفَ اليَوْمِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqraʾu l-kutuba l-ʿarabiyyata wal-majallāti l-usbūʿiyyata waṣ-ṣuḥufa l-yawmiyya
dialogue.en: He reads Arabic books, weekly magazines and daily newspapers.
dialogue.ur: Woh arabi kitabein, haftawar risale aur roznama akhbarat parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ لَهُمْ: إِنَّ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ لُغَةٌ سَهْلَةٌ، وَهِيَ لُغَةُ العِبادَةِ لِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِلْيارٍ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ، وَلُغَةُ القُرْآنِ وَالإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla lahum: inna l-lughata l-ʿarabiyya lughatun sahla, wa hiya lughatu l-ʿibādati li-akthara min milyārin mina l-muslimīn, wa lughatu l-Qurʾāni wal-islām
dialogue.en: And he told them: Arabic is an easy language; it is the language of worship for more than a billion Muslims, and the language of the Quran and Islam.
dialogue.ur: Aur us ne unse kaha: arabi aasaan zabaan hai, yeh ek arab se zyada musalmanon ki ibadat ki zabaan hai, aur Quran aur Islam ki zabaan hai.

intro.en: A midterm review of Units 1 to 8: reading comprehension, true or false, grammar, vocabulary and arranging words into sentences. The passage tells how Muslims carried Arabic-Islamic civilisation and science to Europe.
intro.ur: Unit 1 se 8 ki nisf-e-sal dohrai: parhna aur samajhna, sahi ya galat, qawaid, alfaz aur lafzon se jumle banana. Matn bayan karta hai ke musalmanon ne arabi-islami tehzeeb aur uloom Europe tak kaise pohanchaye.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحَداتِ مِنَ الأولى إِلى الثّامِنَةِ: فَهْمُ المَقْروءِ، وَالصَّوابُ وَالخَطَأُ، وَالقَواعِدُ، وَالمُفْرَداتُ، وَتَرْتيبُ الكَلِماتِ في جُمَلٍ. يَحْكي النَّصُّ كَيْفَ نَقَلَ المُسْلِمونَ الحَضارَةَ وَالعُلومَ إِلى أُوروبّا.

dialogue.ar: وَصَلَ المُسْلِمونَ إِلى بِلادٍ بَعيدَةٍ في الماضي مِنَ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: waṣala l-muslimūna ilā bilādin baʿīdatin fī l-māḍī mina l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: In the past, Muslims reached faraway lands of the world.
dialogue.ur: Maazi mein musalman duniya ke door daraaz mulkon tak pohanche.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ حَمَلوا مَعَهُمُ الحَضارَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ إِلى بَعْضِ المُدُنِ وَالدُّوَلِ في أُوروبّا مِثْلِ: إِيطاليا، وَفَرَنْسا، وَإِسْبانيا.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ḥamalū maʿahumu l-ḥaḍārata l-ʿarabiyyata l-islāmiyya ilā baʿḍi l-mudun wad-duwali fī Ūrūbbā mithli: Īṭāliyā, wa Faransā, wa Isbāniyā
dialogue.en: They carried the Arab-Islamic civilisation with them to some cities and countries in Europe such as Italy, France and Spain.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne saath arabi-islami tehzeeb Europe ke kuch shehron aur mulkon tak le gaye, jaise Italy, France aur Spain.

dialogue.ar: وَظَلَّتْ آثارُ الحَضارَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ إِلى اليَوْمِ؛ فَنَحْنُ نَرى آثارَ هَذِهِ الحَضارَةِ في صِقِلِّيَّةَ، وَفَرَنْسا، وَإِسْبانيا.
dialogue.tr: wa ẓallat āthāru l-ḥaḍārati l-islāmiyya ilā l-yawm; fa-naḥnu narā āthāra hādhihi l-ḥaḍārati fī Ṣiqilliyya, wa Faransā, wa Isbāniyā
dialogue.en: The traces of Islamic civilisation have remained until today; we see its traces in Sicily, France and Spain.
dialogue.ur: Islami tehzeeb ke asaar aaj tak baqi hain; hum in asaar ko Sicily, France aur Spain mein dekhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ قامَتِ العُلومُ الغَرْبِيَّةُ الحَديثَةُ عَلى أَساسِ العُلومِ العَرَبِيَّةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ الَّتي كانَتْ في مَعاهِدِ المُسْلِمينَ في بَغْدادَ وَقُرْطُبَةَ وَإِشْبيلِيَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad qāmati l-ʿulūmu l-gharbiyyatu l-ḥadītha ʿalā asāsi l-ʿulūmi l-ʿarabiyyati l-islāmiyyati llatī kānat fī maʿāhidi l-muslimīn fī Baghdād wa Qurṭuba wa Ishbīliya
dialogue.en: Modern Western sciences were built on the basis of the Arab-Islamic sciences that were in the Muslims' institutes in Baghdad, Cordoba and Seville.
dialogue.ur: Jadeed maghribi uloom un arabi-islami uloom ki bunyad par qayam hue jo Baghdad, Qurtuba aur Ishbiliya ke musalmanon ke idaron mein thay.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الطُّلّابُ يَحْضُرونَ مِنْ أُوروبّا لِلدِّراسَةِ في هَذِهِ المَعاهِدِ، ثُمَّ يَعودونَ إِلى بِلادِهِمْ، وَهُمْ يَحْمِلونَ كُتُبَ العُلومِ العَرَبِيَّةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ مَعَهُمْ إِلى أُوروبّا مِثْلَ: الطِّبِّ، وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ، وَالفَلَكِ، وَالهَنْدَسَةِ وَغَيْرِها.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna ṭ-ṭullābu yaḥḍurūna min Ūrūbbā lid-dirāsati fī hādhihi l-maʿāhid, thumma yaʿūdūna ilā bilādihim, wa hum yaḥmilūna kutuba l-ʿulūmi l-ʿarabiyyati l-islāmiyyati maʿahum ilā Ūrūbbā mithla: aṭ-ṭibb, war-riyāḍiyyāt, wal-falak, wal-handasa wa ghayrihā
dialogue.en: Students used to come from Europe to study at these institutes, then return to their countries carrying the books of Arab-Islamic sciences, such as medicine, mathematics, astronomy and engineering.
dialogue.ur: Europe se talba in idaron mein parhne aate, phir apne mulkon ko lautte aur arabi-islami uloom ki kitabein saath le jaate, jaise tibb, riyazi, falkiyat aur handasa.

q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq musalmanon ne arabi-islami tehzeeb duniya ke kis hisse tak pohanchai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ جُزْءٍ مِنَ العالَمِ نَقَلَ المُسْلِمونَ الحَضارَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Which science is mentioned as carried to Europe?
q.ur: Europe le jaye gaye uloom mein se kaun sa matn mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِلْمٍ ذُكِرَ أَنَّهُ نُقِلَ إِلى أُوروبّا؟

q.en: Put the words in order: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
q.ur: Alfaz ko tarteeb dein: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
q.ar: رَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ في جُمْلَةٍ: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
